generationRules.gapFormula: mean(max(0, targetMastery-currentMastery)) over all observed required skills; null excluded
generationRules.prerequisiteAssumption: Observed skill >=.75 requires observed direct prerequisites >= catalog minMastery; unknown prerequisites unresolved
generationRules.sampling: Seed 43 by default; cover all roles within 20/15/15 domain quotas; preserve 40 typical/10 challenging and 15 cross-domain profiles; greedily diversify gap then coverage then type then cross-domain strength then role
generationRules.samplingCaveat: Coverage sample; gap ratios need not match the 500-user population; report per-stratum outcomes
